scope: Clearance resume adopts an exact live episode rather than falling back to a fresh task
finding: The previous resume expression evaluated false for an absent or different-target durable order, then followed fresh-clear semantics. An old resume request could therefore start a new episode or replace another clear. Missing-target retirement also lacked a matching snapshot guard; destroyed-target resume did not retire its durable order.
change: Discovery supplies observed order and generation. Resume requires nonempty matching live order, target and generation at entry, before expiry/handoff, and before publication. Missing/different/replaced requests refuse. Missing or destroyed targets retire only a still-matching resumed order. Explicit fresh task semantics and original deadlines remain.
fixture: PREPARED normal moved-building case replays the genuine old snapshot after cancellation and after a fresh replacement; requires refusal, no resurrection, exact replacement preservation, then actual two-actor entry. No durable state or completion injection.
limits: No actual-provider HC timing, JIP, repeated physical clearance or runtime overhead acceptance.
Admission remains a multi-stage routine; this does not prove every possible scheduled interleaving is atomic.
Malformed public orders and broader fresh-task admission interleavings are not comprehensively resolved here.
